field_updates.detail: Conditional coordinate derivation: manufacturer top-view PLUS upper-right, MINUS upper-left, AC lower-left/lower-right. Rotate90deg counterclockwise: PLUS(-X,+Y),MINUS(-X,-Y),AC(+X,-Y),AC(+X,+Y). Assumed library top-left-first counterclockwise numbering then gives1PLUS,2MINUS,3AC,4AC. Manufacturer drawing does not supply these library numbers; retain binding blocker until source package convention is independently tested. Library convention provenance: PCB_COMPONENT_3D_LIBRARY_SPEC.md Section6 and OHM-071, not an electrical manufacturer claim.
